subject: Join us at Every's inaugural conference

messages.subject: Join us at Every's inaugural conference
messages.body:
( https://orrell.example )

Your subscription includes the livestream. Apply to join us IRL at Pioneer Works.

( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027 )

Hey there,

Yesterday we launched our inaugural conference, ​Praxis: 2027 ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027 )​. If you read Every, you know our mission is to live in the future of work and report back. So we're bringing the people building that future together in person this November. And you can get $350 off right now with early bird pricing.

-->Apply to attend ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/apply )
Apply to attend ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/apply )Why are we doing a conference?

A few months ago, we published ​"After Automation," ( https://orrell.example/p/after-automation )​ our Praxis that the more we use AI, the more that's left for humans to do. We think that there's a bright future for people and AI doing more interesting, creative, and impactful work together. On November 5, we're exploring that future at Pioneer Works in Red Hook, Brooklyn for our inaugural conference: Praxis: 2027. We hope you'll join us.

-->Explore Praxis: 2027 ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027 )
Explore Praxis: 2027 ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027 )We're filling Pioneer Works with people shaping what comes after automation, and eager to debate it.

Launch speakers include:

* Liam Fletcher (CEO, Every), Maya Lindqvist (editor in chief, Every), and Ryan Gallagher (general manager of Cora, Every)
* Marcus Vance (founder and CEO, Notion)
* Ethan Bradley (cofounder and CEO, The Browser Company of New York)
* Lucas Thorne (member of technical staff, Codex at OpenAI)
* Mateo Reynolds (cofounder and co-CEO, Runway)
* Claire Davenport (partner, Sequoia)
* And more big names to come.

Early bird pricing is now live.

Apply by September 2 at 11:59 p.m. ET to lock in a $1,150 ticket and save $350. Tickets come with one full year of Every All Access, including $8,000+ in AI credits with the ​Builder Pack ( https://orrell.example/builder-pack )​. Payment is requested only after acceptance.

-->Apply to attend ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/apply )
Apply to attend ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/apply )Know someone who should be there?

Nominate them. We'll be giving away a limited number of free tickets to our favorite nominees.

-->Nominate an attendee ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/nominate )
Nominate an attendee ( https://orrell.example/Praxis-2027/nominate )See you in Brooklyn,
Every

P.S. Can't make it? No problem. We'll be livestreaming the entire conference for free. As a paid Every subscriber, you'll also have access to the full Kestrel library after the conference wraps. Keep an eye out for updates.
